name: growther-android
description: Growther Capacitor Android app with direct Google Play Billing

scripts.build:billing-bridge: node sync-site.js && esbuild src/google-play-billing.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=site-package/google-play-billing.bundle.js && esbuild src/google-play-billing.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=google-play-billing.bundle.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:billing-bridge && cap sync android
